speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash. To help me understand what you are dealing with, can you tell me how old the baby is in days, and when did the rash first appear?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Conjunctivitis (with secondary cutaneous dissemination). The history of maternal gonorrhea, term birth, and a generalized rash appearing one day after birth strongly suggest disseminated gonococcal infection, which can present with a pustular rash in neonates. I recommend immediate consultation with pediatric infectious disease and initiation of intravenous ceftriaxone while awaiting culture results.
